subject.title: feat: add tools.fs.roots — per-agent filesystem roots with access modes

question: Should OpenClaw accept `tools.fs.roots` as a core security/config contract once the localRoots workspace-widening blocker is fixed?
rationale: This PR creates a new operator-controlled filesystem boundary and public SDK/media plumbing; automation can repair the narrow bug, but maintainers should explicitly own the final security/product contract.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Fix the explicit-root widening bug, rebase the branch, rerun focused security/media validation, and then proceed with maintainer security review.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Limit the PR to host FS tools first and defer outbound media/plugin SDK propagation to a follow-up design review.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Close or pause the branch if maintainers do not want a new core filesystem root config surface right now.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the explicit-root widening bug, rebase the branch, rerun focused security/media validation, and then proceed with maintainer security review.
